gender_signal.instructions: Does the cricket question explicitly say women's or men's?

criteria.women: the question explicitly asks about women's cricket (women, female, WPL, WT20I, feminine wording)
criteria.men: the question explicitly asks about men's cricket (men, male, IPL, masculine wording)
criteria.both_named: the question names both women's and men's cricket
criteria.none: no explicit gender is stated; the question does not say women's or men's

criteria.cricket_stat: asks for a cricket record, statistic, result, winner or ranking
criteria.cricket_general: a cricket question that is not a record (rules, pitch length, how the game works)
criteria.other_sport_stat: asks for a record or statistic in a sport other than cricket

family.instructions: Which kind of cricket record does the question ask for?

criteria.career_record: a player's career total or best, such as most runs, wickets or centuries
criteria.world_cup_record: about the World Cup: winners, titles, top scorers, first edition
criteria.firsts_history: a first in cricket history, such as the first match or first double century
criteria.team_record: a team record: lowest total, biggest win, highest chase, most wins
criteria.player_stat: stats or a career summary for one named player
criteria.recent_result: the latest or most recent match result
criteria.role_or_ranking: a captain or a number-one ranking
criteria.other_stat: a cricket statistic that fits none of the other families

format.instructions: Which cricket format does the question mean?

criteria.league: a franchise league such as IPL, WPL, BBL or WBBL

stat_career_record.instructions: Which exact career record statistic is asked?

stat_role_or_ranking.instructions: Which exact role or ranking statistic is asked?

criteria.number_one: who is ranked number one or the best

stat_player_stat.instructions: Which exact player stat statistic is asked?

criteria.vs_team: a player's record against one team

stat_world_cup_record.instructions: Which exact world cup record statistic is asked?

criteria.first_edition: when or where the first World Cup was played
criteria.latest_winner: who won the most recent World Cup
criteria.most_titles: which team has won the most World Cups
criteria.edition_winner: who won a World Cup in a named year
criteria.edition_top_scorer: top run scorer of a World Cup in a named year

stat_firsts_history.instructions: Which exact firsts history statistic is asked?

criteria.other_first: any other first in cricket history

stat_team_record.instructions: Which exact team record statistic is asked?
